headline: Bitcoin slid below $58,000 on Friday as liquidations topped $1.5 billion, Anthropic's shares fell back toward their IPO price, and talk of a December Fed rate hike pushed investors into cash.

market.asOf: Read around 20:00 UTC Fri 20 Nov (about 03:00 Sat Bangkok) from CoinMarketCap. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 12 out of 100 (Extreme Fear) on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index, read about 20:00 UTC 20 Nov; yesterday it was 10

stories.title: Bitcoin falls below $58,000 as more than $1.5 billion of bets are wiped out
stories.summary: Bitcoin kept falling after the US stock market opened on Friday, dropping under $60,000, then $59,000, and by mid-afternoon in New York below $58,000. Traders who had borrowed to bet on higher prices were forced out, and big funds kept pulling money from bitcoin ETFs. Shares of crypto miners and of bitcoin-holding company Strategy fell with it.
points: Bitcoin was at $57,961, down 7.6% in 24 hours, at 2:20 p.m. ET, and down 15% on the week and 30.9% on the month, per Bitcoin.com News.
Bitcoin.com called it the lowest price since September 2024; CoinDesk points to the $57,700 low of June-July as the bear-market low, so the sources differ on how far back the comparison goes.
Liquidations across crypto reached $1.53 billion in 24 hours, more than $1.38 billion of it bets on rising prices, per Bitcoin.com News.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $582.3 million on Thursday 19 Nov, $541.1 million of it from BlackRock's IBIT, per Yahoo Finance.
Strategy (MSTR) shares fell to around $80, a new 52-week low, per KuCoin News.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: bitcoin at lowest price since 2024
KuCoin News: Strategy stock hits 52-week low

stories.title: Anthropic gives back most of its first-day gain as AI and chip stocks slide
stories.summary: Anthropic's shares, which opened their first Nasdaq day at $111.50 and closed it at $97.17, fell back toward the $83 IPO price on day two. Chip stocks and the Nasdaq fell hard too, and crypto has been moving in step with AI stocks, so bitcoin miners were among the biggest losers. Friday's closing price was not out when this was written.
points: Anthropic traded around $86 on Friday, about 11% lower on the day and about $3 above its IPO price, per Fortune.
On its first day it hit a high of $115.10 before closing at $97.17, per Fortune.
The SOXX chip-stock fund was down 7.8% and the Nasdaq 3% at midday, per CoinDesk.
Miner stocks fell: Hut 8 about 15%, Core Scientific and Bitdeer each more than 13%, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: Fortune: Anthropic stock teeters close to IPO price

stories.title: Fears of a December Fed rate hike send investors into cash
stories.summary: The Fed meets on 9 December, and markets expect it to raise interest rates, not cut them. Higher rates make cash and government bonds pay more, which makes assets that pay no interest, like bitcoin and gold, less attractive. Gold and silver fell along with crypto on Friday.
points: Fed Governor Lisa Cook said she had favored a rate hike in October and put October headline inflation at 3.8%, per CoinDesk.
A quarter-point hike to 4.00-4.25% is still seen as the most likely outcome, per CoinDesk.
Prediction market Polymarket showed a 94% chance of a hike on 9 Dec, per Yahoo Finance.
Gold futures fell 4.3% to $3,521 and silver 7% to $41.27, per Bitcoin.com News.
"The place to hide is cash," Maxime Seiler of STS Digital told CoinDesk.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: gold and silver slide

briefs.title: Binance hack funds being mixed
briefs.summary: Elliptic says launderers of the Binance hack proceeds have pushed at least 2,310 BTC, about $149 million, through mixers, roughly 90% of it since Tuesday, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto tax bill may get a House vote
briefs.summary: Rep. Horsford wants a House vote on the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act, which cleared committee 38-5, before this Congress ends; paying a fee of $10 or less in crypto would not count as a gain or loss, and wash-sale rules would apply to crypto, per The Block.

briefs.title: Death Bets Act heads to the House
briefs.summary: The Senate passed a bill by voice vote that would ban CFTC-registered exchanges from listing contracts on war, terrorism, assassination or a person's death; it now goes to the House, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Ether funds keep losing money
briefs.summary: US spot ether ETFs had net outflows of $131.2 million on 19 Nov, per The Block.

briefs.title: Galaxy shares slide
briefs.summary: Galaxy (GLXY) fell 8% on the day to $11.09 and more than 20% on the week, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Binance.US exchange applications move forward
briefs.summary: The CFTC deemed Binance.US's applications to run a regulated futures exchange and clearing house "substantially complete"; they are not approved yet, per Coin Gabbar.

briefs.title: Crypto lobby told to "clean house"
briefs.summary: Wintermute's policy chief Ron Hammond said the crypto lobby needs to "clean house a little bit" after setbacks in Washington, per The Block.

calendar.event: US PCE inflation (Oct), Q3 GDP (second estimate), durable goods and jobless claims
calendar.note: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Core PCE expected 3.2% a year (prior 3.1%), per ForexFundamentals; Continuum Economics expects headline PCE 3.8% (from 3.6%). GDP's advance estimate was 3.4%, per BEA. Jobless claims move up from Thursday; last week was 203,000, per InvestingLive.
The Fed's survey of business conditions around the country, per the Fed's calendar.

calendar.event: Thanksgiving: US stock and bond markets closed
calendar.note: On Friday 27 Nov US stocks close early at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per LiteFinance. Crypto trades all day, but thin trading can mean bigger swings.
CryptoQuant puts the size of the 27 November expiry at about $6.5 billion.
The last jobs report before the Fed decision, per the BLS schedule. JOLTS job openings come out Tue 1 Dec at 10:00am ET; November CPI is Thu 10 Dec, the day after the Fed.

calendar.event: Next Fed meeting and rate decision
calendar.note: Decision Wed 9 Dec at 2:00pm ET (02:00 Thu Bangkok). The current range is 3.75-4.00%. Markets expect a hike: Seoul Economic Daily on 20 Nov reported CME FedWatch odds of 90% for a quarter-point rise and 10% for a half point; Polymarket showed 94% for a hike, per Yahoo Finance.
